agent_priors_used: General prior (not SPIDER evidence): information gain of an experiment is bounded by variance in the outcome that the currently-frozen measurement substrate can express; a saturated comparator or a saturated task bank yields no discriminating signal.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): a benchmark result computed only over internal arms cannot support a market-level moat claim; competitor-strength controls are required, so external comparator readiness is a first-class concern even though it is non-gating for this cycle.
General prior (not SPIDER evidence): verification/abstention must be exercised against out-of-grammar inputs to be trusted; systems that only see in-grammar positives silently over-accept.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): local CPU-quantized small models (<=8B) are known-weak at closed-loop multi-step browser control; scaling the class and re-pinning byte-exact weights is a legitimate but low-confidence probe, so it must carry an explicit stop rule.

General prior (not SPIDER evidence): single-vantage web measurements have limited external validity; an independent second egress materially strengthens or bounds a persistence/denylist claim, but only if that second egress is actually provisionable (a Tor exit is a conservative, Tor-specific proxy, not a generic vantage).
General prior (not SPIDER evidence): repeated design-stage failures under one control revision are a substrate/process signal, not evidence about the scientific hypothesis.

allocation.question: Can a hardened V3 credential-free bank be constructed and certified pre-freeze such that its success requires mechanism- or composition-dependent (memory-carried) behavior - supplying a memory-robust, non-ceiling dynamic range that a frozen within-session memoryful comparator (e.g. chain-to-precursor-distance / receipt-log state) cannot reach - thereby discharging readiness blocker B2 without invoking or requiring an LLM endpoint?
allocation.rationale: Runtime is IDLE and this is the highest-connectivity unblocked substrate work in the program: it decides whether the flagship four-arm benchmark's dynamic range is real or a comparator artifact. Decision counterfactual: a certified memory-robust bank (comparator materially below the bank's achievable ceiling) discharges B2 and unblocks the benchmark for a later cycle; the alternative - showing the claimed separation collapses to a memoryless/memoryful-comparator artifact - is a decisive bounded negative that stops the benchmark from being built on an invalid substrate and redirects Product to redesign, so the experiment cannot return 'neither'. Strongest fair baseline: the frozen memoryless comparator from EXP-RUNTIME-38182129488 that already reproduces the (K-1)/K separation (artifact-robust separation=.974) PLUS a stronger within-session memoryful comparator (receipt log / chain-to-precursor distance) that reaches 1.0, so the new bank must beat a live memoryful null, not just a memoryless one. Validity/dependency: credential-free and deterministic, so it does not depend on B3 and can run in parallel with Intel's endpoint work; the pre-freeze certificate must fix the dynamic-range definition and the comparator strength before outcomes. Stop/budget rule: the smallest-decisive-batch is one frozen bank plus the two comparators, with a pre-declared ceiling-vs-comparator separation threshold; if no constructible bank exceeds the memoryful comparator, record the bounded substrate-class negative and stop (do not iterate banks indefinitely, and do not re-open the same failure). Cognitive-reset note: the lane's tunnel_flag=true and 10/10 recent C-MEAS-VALID streak are advisory only and not a quota; if this lane had encountered today's Codex with no handoff it would still face the memory-robust-dynamic-range question, so the direction wins on merits. Product discipline is preserved: success does not promote any mechanism to Product Core, it only supplies substrate.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Two factories, one science budget. The results-driven product loop over capable browser agents must not wait on Physics or Frontier; the research portfolio therefore concentrates on removing the shared validity blockers of the flagship inheritance/economics benchmark and on completing/validating only the accepted positives whose external validity or safety boundary is a live product risk. Current state (codex/claim_state.json.effective_event_by_claim): C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED, C-DELTA-REPAIR / C-FRESHNESS / C-PARAM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY EXPERIMENTAL, C-CROSSSITE / C-LLM-INHERIT / C-PRODUCT-ECON / C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE / C-WEB-DYNAMICS HYPOTHESIS. Flagship readiness: B1 DISCHARGED (EXP-PRODUCT-38186502935 shipped a pre-freeze executable inherited parameterized mechanism plus a known-negative refusal); B2 NOT satisfied (EXP-RUNTIME-38169622704 passed its V2 certificate, but EXP-RUNTIME-38182129488 showed the (K-1)/K separation is reproducible by a memoryless comparator, artifact-robust separation=.974; a memoryful comparator reaches 1.0); B3 NOT satisfied (Intel's local 3B-8B Qwen ceiling holds and no hosted same-protocol endpoint is provisioned). Per the standing readiness rule I will NOT fund the expensive four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark until all three conditions hold; instead this cycle removes B2 (Runtime) and B3 (Intel) and closes a product safety boundary (Product). Two lanes carry unfinished committed transactions: Frontier is FROZEN (EXP-FRONTIER-38188815194) and Graph/Physics/Product hold strategically-correct PREFREEZE mandates. Frontier/Graph/Physics/Product are CONTINUE-with-USE (complete or resume the existing pre-freeze mandate, no scientific redirection). Runtime and Intel are IDLE and are REOPENED on the specific blockers they gate. Operational note for the ops/control plane (not a lane re-allocation): Graph (exit 65), Physics (exit 1) and Product (exit 66) pre-freeze design stages all failed within minutes under the same control_revision 905755fa5dcc3c912dd33bb57014ee285149120ba2ab868a0b275a79ed2c742c, and Physics carries a repeated design-review rejection (model_design_review attempt 4, category substantive). These are pre-freeze control/design iterations, NOT scientific negatives and NOT a reason to change direction; they should be repaired once at the design-harness layer rather than re-discovered as per-lane MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Physics is the one lane where the direction itself has a pre-declared operational stop rule (see below), because its mandate requires a substrate that the design stage has repeatedly failed to certify.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout brief did not change the direction decision and is treated as staff advice only. It arrived in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (process exited rc=139) with no completed external reconnaissance, and its candidate directions simply echo the lane handoffs (Frontier persistence economics, Product carrier boundary, Runtime dynamic-range bank, Intel endpoint capability). I therefore used it as a completeness checklist against the machine snapshot, not as authority. I did not act on any Scout claim about external competitors or datasets, because none was substantiated; the one external item that matters for later market-level claims (competitor-strength controls, e.g. native Stagehand-like caching) is recorded as a non-gating prerequisite inside the Intel allocation rather than promoted to a driving question this cycle. Where the Scout and the Codex could be compared, the Codex controlled the decision.
